question: Shrek won the first ever Academy Award in which category?
why: As written it reads as if Shrek won the first Academy Award ever given; the fact is that it won the first Oscar awarded in the new Best Animated Feature category (2002).

fix.question: Shrek won the first ever Oscar handed out in which category?

question: In Up, what is the name of the young Wilderness Explorer who stows away on Carl's house?
why: Russell does not stow away on purpose; he is stuck on the porch looking for a snipe when the house lifts off, so a pedant at the bar could argue the premise.
